newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Coast names Moore COO and promotes two.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Coast names Moore COO and promotes two.

text.p: Atlantic Coast Airlines Inc said Wednesday it named Thomas Moore to the newly created post of executive vice president and chief operating officer.
The company also said it had named John Cross to vice president of technical services, and Angie Shermer to vice president of sales.
Moore has worked at ACA since June 1994 and previously held the position of senior vice president for maintenance and operations.
Cross joined Atlantic Coast in 1990 as manager of one of the company's aircraft maintenance facilities.
Shermer who has been with the company since 1989 was previously director of sales.
